title: On the existence of Markovian measures on continuous paths
summary: Let $\mathbfη$ be a positive Radon measure on the space of continuous paths from R into a locally compact Polish space $Y$, and assume that $\mathbfη$ admits an invariant measure. We explicit conditions on $\mathbfη$ such that successive Markovianisation of $\mathbfη$ over any dense and countable set of times have all limit points (in the weak-star topology on Radon measures) satisfying the strong Markov property.
